g.text: Synthetic telemetry: six channels sampled once a minute, driven by a 96-min orbit (36 % eclipse), a commanded payload mode, a 14-day season and slow unmodelled
variations. Grey: signal without the anomaly; dashed: fixed limits (training minimum and maximum). Thresholds are set so that 0.1 % of normal test samples alarm.
